message.content: {"rules":["Calling `try_get_unchecked(it, idx)` requires `0 <= idx` and `idx < it.size()`.","If `I: !Clone`, calling `try_get_unchecked(it, idx)` requires that unchecked access with the same index never be performed on that iterator more than once. Counts are added together across the iterator and any values obtained from it by coercion to supertypes, including multiple successive coercions.","After `try_get_unchecked(it, idx)` has been called, `next_back()` may be called on the iterator at most `it.size() - idx - 1` times. If `I: Clone` and the iterator is cloned, this bound is calculated for the iterator and its clone individually, but `next_back()` calls before cloning count for both. Calls across the iterator and values obtained by successive coercions to supertypes are added together for this bound.","After `try_get_unchecked(it, idx)` has been called, only `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` (including access through `try_get_unchecked`), and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size` may be called on the iterator or any new clones. If the iterator is subsequently coerced to a supertype, the same method restriction applies to the resulting value, including after multiple successive coercions.","If `I` is a subtype of `T`, the iterator may be coerced to `T`, including after `try_get_unchecked(it, idx)` has been called. After such a call, only `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` (including access through `try_get_unchecked`), and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size` may be called on the coerced value. Multiple coercion steps are permitted. If `I: !Clone`, unchecked accesses at the same index are counted together across the iterator and all successive coercion results and must not exceed one. After an unchecked access at `idx`, `next_back()` calls are counted together across those values and must not exceed `it.size() - idx - 1`; for clones the bound is calculated individually, with calls before cloning counting for both.","`try_get_unchecked(it, idx)` must not change the value returned by `size_hint`, provided `0 <= idx < it.size()`; if `I: !Clone`, the same index is never accessed unchecked more than once; after the access, at most `it.size() - idx - 1` calls to `next_back()` occur; and afterward only `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` (including access through `try_get_unchecked`), and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size` are called on the iterator, new clones, or subsequent coercion results. For clones, the `next_back()` bound applies individually, with pre-cloning calls counting for both. For clones, the `next_back()` bound applies individually, with pre-cloning calls counting for both.
